thread:
ajay singh: Draft RN + internal announce for tomorrow's deploy. PTAL. Want a 14:00-16:00 PT change window and pin guidance for Dedicated customers. Short snippet below — editing in thread.
ajay singh: ```
Release v2.3.1 (rolling):
- Serving runtime: batching+kv-cache tweaks to reduce tail latency (~8% median improvement)
- Compilation: kernel fallback safety for mixed-precision models
- Ops: improved deploy-time validation to avoid cold-start spikes

Rollback guidance: pin to v2.3.0 if perf regress >5% for more than 5m or error rate >1%.
```

maria gonzalez: small wording nit — call out Dedicated customers and include the maintenance window in the header. also add a short line about user-facing risk = low.
ajay singh: updated below per maria. moved window into header and added dedicated pin suggestion.
ajay singh: ```
HEADER: Maintenance window 14:00-16:00 PT. Impact: low. Dedicated customers may be pinned to v2.3.0 for first hour by request.

Release v2.3.1 (rolling):
- Serving runtime: batching+kv-cache tweaks to reduce tail latency (~8% median improvement)
- Compilation: kernel fallback safety for mixed-precision models
- Ops: deploy-time validation to reduce cold-start spikes

Rollback guidance: if perf regress >5% for >5m or error rate >1% across production canary, pin region to `v2.3.0` and notify #incidents.
```

sasha lee: add explicit ops rollback steps (who runs it, quick commands, and expected window). also include evaulation guard (latency/requests) so product knows thresholds.
ops-oncall: change window acked: 14:00-16:00 PT. Oncall coverage: @elaine initial 14:00-15:30, handoff to @maria 15:30-16:00. Standby channel: #incidents. We'll have runbook at hand.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy started: release=v2.3.1 env=staging -> prod canary at 4821347680
elaine: I'll cover initial window. will watch latency dashboard and paging. if anything noisy ping me directly and escalate to ops-oncall.
ajay singh: added a compact rollback snippet for the runbook:
ajay singh: ```bash
# pin to previous release in k8s (example)
kubectl set image deployment/inference inference=redwood/inference:v2.3.0 -n inference-prod
# or trigger service pin in deploy dashboard: /pin service=inference tag=v2.3.0
# expected promotion back to prod once metrics stable (~30-60m)
```

maria gonzalez: :thumbsup: Looks good. Suggest we proactively pin Dedicated region `eu-central-1` for the first hour since some customers are on reserved capacity there.
sasha lee: Add an eval gate: if p95 latency > 120ms OR error rate > 0.8% sustained for 5m, trigger rollback. Include automated alert thresholds in the RN so non-ops readers can see the criteria.
ajay singh: final RN copy with pin table and rollback steps attached below. Anyone object to sending internal announce at 13:20 PT today so eng/customer success can prep?
maria gonzalez: no objections. send at 13:20 and include a short checklist for CS to notify dedicated accounts. I'll draft the CS note.
deploy-bot: Canary passed thresholds at 4821347715. Promoting to prod at 4821347725.
ops-oncall: note: rollback command tested on staging, infra alerted, dashboards pinned. if rollout shows any regress beyond thresholds, we will pin and open an incident ticket.
elaine: confirmed handoff plan. I'll be watching until 15:30 then hand to @maria. all set on my end.
maria gonzalez: approving internal blast. will include pinned message for dedicated customers and the rollback table. :rocket:
